# Mathematical reference data

ciede2000_sharma.txt: 34 numerical test pairs from G. Sharma, W. Wu and E. Dalal,
2005, DOI 10.1002/col.20070; downloaded 2026-09-10 from the authors' supplementary
[test data](https://hajim.rochester.edu/ece/sites/gsharma/ciede2000/dataNprograms/ciede2000testdata.txt).
Used only as numerical verification fixtures, no upstream implementation copied.
Keep attribution; no standalone commercial license for the supplementary file
was asserted by this project. Reassess fixture redistribution before publication.
